ideas.topic: The Hidden Mechanism of the 'Self-Filling' Libation Bowls
ideas.hook: Did the Ancient Egyptians have access to siphons and hydraulic engineering thousands of years ago?
ideas.why: It leverages the fascination with 'ancient technology' and mysterious mechanisms similar to the viral 'holy water' animation, while maintaining a scholarly tone.

ideas.topic: Why Ancient Egyptian Makeup Wasn't Just for Beauty
ideas.hook: That iconic black eyeliner wasn't just a style choice—it actually saved their eyesight.
ideas.why: It follows the successful 'Fact Check' format by debunking a common aesthetic perception with a practical, scientific, and historically grounded benefit.

ideas.topic: What Archaeologists Found Inside a 3,000-Year-Old Sealed Jar
ideas.hook: When this clay jar was opened for the first time in millennia, the smell was still trapped inside.
ideas.why: It uses the 'sensory curiosity' hook—very popular in high-performing archaeological shorts—to invite viewers to learn about historical preservation and daily life.
